name: Reboxetine
metabolism: Mainly metabolized by CYP3A4, including O-desethylation. CYP2D6 is not a major metabolic route; urinary elimination includes drug-related metabolites.
summary: Reboxetine is a selective norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor marketed in many countries as an antidepressant for major depressive disorder. It is not approved for use in the United States.
